prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset ID: arrival-pod-ground-glow-reinforcement.
From this exact reference create a transparent LIGHT-ONLY reinforcement overlay. Preserve the complete original PORTRAIT canvas, exactly1024pixelswide by1536pixelshigh, and preserve the ABSOLUTE position of the THREE orange lamps. Do not crop, recenter, resize or redraw the lamp locations.
Remove all visible capsule body from the output, keeping only a modest soft amber-orange extra glow precisely centred over the three original lamps. Exact source centres from top-left: upper(501,78), lower-left(450,119), lower-right(551,119). The two lower centres must be at y119, NOT y124. The upper centre must be at x501, NOT x505. Be especially careful about those five-pixel shifts: this output will be superimposed directly over the source at identical full-canvas scale.
Three small pale-amber cores with 10px radius and soft orange halos of about25px radius, no visible lamp housing. Each glow is compact, remains visibly separate, feathers to transparent naturally; no broad atmospheric glow. All alpha is zero outside x410..590,y35..160. The rest of the full tall canvas is EMPTY TRANSPARENT, including all edges. Keep this large empty canvas.
Output ONE RGBA PNG with true transparent background. ONLY the three emission halos, no metal, body, door, hull, sockets, reflections, exhaust, smoke, flames, rays, text, scenery, floor, shadows, checkerboard, white or black background. This is EXTRA light on top of the existing unmodified source, not an extraction or separation of baked source lighting. No change in the reference lamp positions.

technicalQA.emissionRegistrationMethod: Centroid of R>240,G>195,alpha>200 within a40x40ROI around each measured source core. Source centres use R>240,G>195,alpha>240. This measures a visual core region, not an exact extracted mask.
